chants.vernacular_text: I have called out because you answer me, O God; incline your ear and hear my words; keep me, O Lord, like the apple of your eye; protect me under the shadow of your wings. ℣. Hear my just cause, O Lord; attend to my supplication.
Save your people, O Lord, and bless your inheritance. ℣. Unto you have I cried, O Lord; O my God, be not silent with me, lest I become like those who go down into the grave.
Praise the Lord, O my soul; I will praise the Lord throughout my life; I will sing in honour of my God as long as I have being.
I shall meditate upon your commandments which I greatly love; I will extend my hands towards your commandments which I love.
O Lord our governor, how admirable is your name in all the earth!
